translation: At the places of silted accumulation, the skin is rough; if it is rubbed and broken, apply alum (礬), and the scab forms and heals faster. First apply alum, and one can avoid abrasion and injury. Or use a large lump of alum in place of rubbing, and one can also scrape and grind the accumulation on the sinews and bones, achieving twice the merit with half the effort.
